scientific_limitations: Exact conclusion only for independent homogeneous undirected bond percolation on finite paths with one fixed initial seed.
Not a theorem about time-dependent infections, correlated transmissions, all trees, or general contact networks.
Pairwise crossover probabilities depend on both locations and path order; no common threshold is claimed.
title: Every two seed locations on a finite epidemic path have one variance-ranking crossover
